$description: What is enforced vs convention for token usage.

rawValueRestrictions.color: Use palette/semantic tokens only; no new colours (all 21 palette colours have usage in the colour histogram).
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: Use fluid design-px values (x --u); fixedPx tokens must stay raw px.
rawValueRestrictions.radius: Use radius tokens; 99vw pill and 50% circle only for pills/dots.
rawValueRestrictions.typography: Use typography.style.* only; mobile step-down per semantic.typography.mobileStepDown.

overrides: PageSpec instances carry NO per-instance style/token override field: styling is owned by section/component contracts. There is therefore nothing token-shaped to validate inside a PageSpec; token drift is checked at the catalog/contract layer (verify_all.py: contract token refs resolve in the catalog).

machineChecked: every tokens[] ref in primitives/components/sections resolves in the catalog
policy categories are real catalog prefixes
